_doc: Verified festival dates. Evidence: docs/data-source-check.md (Part 2, section A). Do not edit without new evidence.

rule.festival_days: D and D+1 (local IST calendar dates)
rule.baseline_days: D-14 .. D-8 (7 local dates, before Dhanteras/pre-Diwali activity)
rule.bulletin_alignment: CPCB bulletin dated X = average of 16:00 IST on X-1 to 16:00 IST on X. Festival nights D and D+1 therefore appear in bulletins dated D+1 and D+2; baseline bulletins are D-13 .. D-7.

2024.note: DoPT: Thu 31 Oct 2024. Drik Panchang (New Delhi): 1 Nov. Festival days D, D+1 = 31 Oct + 1 Nov.

2025.note: DoPT and Drik Panchang: Mon 20 Oct 2025.

2026.note: DoPT 2026 list (secondary copies): Sun 8 Nov 2026. Measured data only after it happens.
